description: dotnet run of an asm program with the CLI's run switches: the arguments after --, the launch profiles of Properties/launchSettings.json (the default one, -lp, --no-launch-profile; -- arguments replace a profile's), -e alone and over a profile's variable, a run from the project's own folder, --no-build with -c, an artifacts path and -f (dotnet run has no use-current-runtime switch: it would hand --ucr to the program). The program prints what it got and exits with the number of arguments, so each step checks both.

steps.description: The arguments after -- arrive as given, one with a space included; they replace the default profile's arguments, and the profile's variable still applies.
The default launch profile: its two arguments and its variable.
-e sets a variable for the program.
-e wins over the profile's value of the same variable.
dotnet run in the project's own folder, with no project named.
--no-build runs the Release build of the step before.
With an artifacts path, dotnet run builds there and runs that build.
